about: the path and confounder claims of Knowledge: the exactness lanes and, on simulated data, each method with true claims against the same fit without them
build: Andrey pre-release build of 9 November 2026 on the 0.16.0 release branch (version string 0.16.0)
verdict_rule: per method, cell, part, and fraction: D = errors(with true claims) - errors(without) per dataset, seeds 0-19; worse when the 95% percentile-bootstrap interval of mean D lies above 0, better when below; a worse row counts only when the same row on seeds 100-119 is worse too. Floor: the interval of errors - empty-graph errors must lie below 0. A part of a method passes when no worse row repeats, every row is below the floor, and its exactness lane has no failure.
error_metric: pairs adjacent in the fit and not in the truth, or the reverse, plus every tail or arrowhead, on a pair adjacent in both, that differs from the true DAG (cpdag, lingam), the true MAG of the observed variables (pag), or the true window MAG (lpcmci); an undirected edge or a circle is never wrong
dropped_note: claims is the number of true claims given to the fits of a row and dropped the number the fits dropped as unmet by the graph they found; knowledge_error counts fits that raised
no_dataset_note: seeds whose graph has too few nodes with two children to hide the cell's hidden nodes; left out of the pag lane
false_claims_note: rows with arm false state 10% of the ordered pairs wrongly: context, not judged
against_lingam_note: D = errors(direct_lingam) - errors(lingam's DirectLiNGAM with the same claims as prior_knowledge) on the datasets both fit; part none is the fit without claims; lingam_failed counts the datasets where lingam raised
